_schema: User-curated water-source overrides. Rendered with a star marker so they stand out from OSM data. Fields per entry: lat (number), lon (number), name (string), type (spring|well|fountain|drinking, default spring), potability (verified|verified-personal|unsafe|unknown, default unknown), reliability (year-round|seasonal|unknown, default unknown), ele (number, metres), note (string). Only entries inside the current A4 selection are drawn.

sources.name: Lunauborn
sources.note: Drinking cups on site. Listed on several hiking websites as a reliable source. Treat before drinking anyway. Verify coordinates against local signage (these are approximate — update if your GPS disagrees).
